```sql
SELECT u."DisplayName", u."Location"
FROM main."users" u
JOIN main."posts" a ON a."OwnerUserId" = u."Id"
JOIN main."posts" q ON q."AcceptedAnswerId" = a."Id"
WHERE a."PostTypeId" = 2
  AND a."CreaionDate" >= '2013-06-01'
  AND a."CreaionDate" < '2013-07-01'
GROUP BY u."Id", u."DisplayName", u."Location"
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
LIMIT 10;
```
